name: How long does an interior finish carpentry project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an interior finish carpentry project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single room receiving standard baseboards and door trim can often be completed in one to two days. Whole-house trim packages or complex installations involving tall ceilings, coffered beams, or intricate crown molding typically take several days to a week or more. The schedule depends on prep work, including removing old trim, repairing drywall blemishes along wall edges, and completing the caulking and painting stages. Having the owner-operator on-site allows us to coordinate carpentry, drywall repairs, and painting consecutively without downtime between separate subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room often takes one to two days, while full-home trim installations or custom architectural details usually require several days to over a week.
